deploy-bot: deploy.event: 2026-03-17T02:11:12Z - rollout r-quant-v2 -> us-west-2 (10% traffic)
maya (sre): Got SLO alert: hosted-infer-usw2 p99 spike + 5xx bump (~20m). p95 looks fine. Traces sparse for the window.
kevin (eng-runtime): Gateway logs show a cluster of kernel errors for route=r-quant-v2 -> immediate 502/504s. Error text: "INFER_ERR: kernel_unavailable -> fallback timeout".
lucy_oncall: Oncall here. Any customer-facing hits? Should support be notified?
daniel (support): Yep — two customers opened tickets reporting repeated 502s on /v1/generate and downstream webhook failures. They triggered heavy client retries.
maya (sre): Quick log query I ran:
```
logs.query("service:inference-gateway AND route:r-quant-v2 AND http.status>=500 | count() by http.status")
```
Found a concentrated spike of 502 and 504 between 5190001200-5190001320. Trace sampling looks reduced; many requests missing spans/x-rw-span-id.
kevin (eng-runtime): Root cause hypothesis: r-quant-v2 was rolled as a canary with a new kernel selection path. Some GPU nodes lacked the required kernel blob -> kernel_unavailable. The gateway waited for fallback which hit retry/backoff and caused proxy timeouts.
maya (sre): Repro steps for dev (small payload to exercise tail):
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -H "X-RW-Trace: debug" \
  -H "X-RW-Model-Route: r-quant-v2" \
  -d '{"inputs":"short prompt"}' \
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
```
Look for response headers: `x-rw-span-id` (missing when trace dropped) and gateway body `{"error":"kernel_unavailable"}`.
kevin (eng-runtime): Immediate mitigations I propose:
- rollback canary to r-quant-v1 in usw2
- enable model fallback header: `X-RW-Fallback: model=r-base-int8` for affected routes
- temporarily increase trace sampling to 100% for the 5m window to capture full traces
lucy_oncall: Initiating rollback now.
deploy-bot: rollback.event: 2026-03-17T02:15:47Z - rollback r-quant-v2 -> r-quant-v1 (us-west-2) confirmed
kevin (eng-runtime): Rollback confirmed. r-quant-v1 serving 100% in usw2.
maya (sre): Post-rollback quick check: p99 dropped close to baseline within ~3m. 5xx fraction trending down. Opening INC: INC-2026-0894 to track customer impact and postmortem.
daniel (support): Notifying impacted customers and temporarily pausing automated retries on our side to avoid amplification.
maya (sre): Action items:
- eng-runtime to add kernel preflight check in rollout pipeline (kevin)
- infra to add healthprobe flag for kernel availability (ops)
- devex to add quick repro/runbook snippet (maya)
- oncall to auto-increase trace sampling during anomalies and add trace-coverage alert
kevin (eng-runtime): Will add kernel preflight. Also found a sampling config change earlier today that reduced trace retention — reverting that and adding an alert for trace-coverage drop.
maya (sre): Leaving this thread open until postmortem. Links: runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.local/inference/kernel-rollout and incident: https://incidents.redwood.local/INC-2026-0894
lucy_oncall: :white_check_mark: monitoring set to 1m, watching for 30m then handoff.
